title: Lightly Smoked Algerian Lamb Kebabs
description: A flavorful and tender dish featuring lamb kebabs marinated in a mixture of white wine vinegar and Mediterranean spices, perfect for a date night dinner. The char-grill flavor adds a smoky touch to the dish.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together white wine vinegar, olive oil, garlic, paprika, cumin, salt, and black pepper to make the marinade.
Add the lamb cubes to the marinade and mix well to coat, then cover the bowl with plastic wrap.
Refrigerate the lamb for at least 2 hours or overnight to allow the flavors to penetrate.
Preheat a grill to medium-high heat and thread the marinated lamb cubes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Brush the grill with oil to prevent sticking and grill the kebabs for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, until they are lightly charred and cooked through.
Transfer the kebabs to a serving plate and sprinkle with chopped parsley.
Serve the kebabs hot with your choice of sides, such as couscous or roasted vegetables.
Garnish with additional parsley if desired.
